channel.title: ShopEase App Release Updates
channel.description: Official RSS updates feed for ShopEase Flutter E-Commerce enterprise multi-role application releases and changelogs.

item.title: ShopEase v2.0.0 Enterprise Release: Multi-Role Portals, Seller Hub, Admin Central, Order Tracking & AI Assistant
item.description: Major enterprise release introducing Seller Merchant Hub, Super Admin Analytics with monthly revenue charts, step-by-step live Order Tracking, GSTIN Tax Invoices, Coupon Codes (WELCOME50, EASE20, FREESHIP), Indian UPI Payments (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm), Side-by-Side Product Comparison, and ShopEase AI Concierge Assistant.

item.title: ShopEase v1.1.0 Released with Developer Mode Bypass & Full Screen Inspection
item.description: Added exclusive circular Developer Settings & Bypass button with PIN 7266 authentication, unlocking instant full-access testing across all screens.

item.title: ShopEase v1.0.0 Released for Android & Web
item.description: Production-ready Android APK and Google Play Store App Bundle (AAB) released with Firebase Auth, Cloud Firestore, Mock Payment, and Material 3 Dark Mode.
